sentences.text:
The petitioner has been denied anticipatory bail by the High Court in connection with Crime No.
253/2025, registered with Sarsiwan Police Station, District  Sarangarh - Bilaigarh, State of Chhattisgarh for the offences punishable under Sections 376 and 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code (for short the, IPC) respectively.

entities.text: Sarsiwan Police Station, District  Sarangarh - Bilaigarh
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
4. Heard Mr. Sawan Datta, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Ms. Ishika Neogi,
the learned counsel appearing for the State of Chhattisgarh.
5.
The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would submit that on the face of it, the First Information Report lodged by the victim is false.
He would submit that the victim is a widow.
She was in a relationship with the petitioner.
6. He would further submit that as the relations went sour due to some reasons, the victim thought fit to go to the Police Station and lodged the FIR for the offences enumerated above.
7. On the other hand, the learned counsel appearing for the State while vehemently opposing the plea for grant of anticipatory bail, submitted that the petitioner is a `Sarpanch and has antecedents.

She would submit that the allegations are serious and in such circumstances, no case for anticipatory bail could be said to have been made out.
8.

Having heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties and having gone through the materials on record, we are of the view that the petitioner has been able to make out a case for grant of anticipatory bail.
9. We do not want to comment anything on merits at this stage.
Investigation is still in progress.

10. In such circumstances, referred to above, we order that in the event of arrest of the petitioner in connection with Crime Number, referred to above, he may be released on bail, subject to the terms and conditions that the Investigating Officer may deem fit to impose.
Once the petitioner is released by the I.O., thereafter he shall appear before the territorial Trial Court and furnish fresh bail.
11. Dasti permitted.
12. With the aforesaid, the Special Leave Petition stands disposed of.
13. Pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of.
(VISHAL ANAND) (POOJA SHARMA)
ASTT. REGISTRAR-cum-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
